name: Warp and resample surface label annotation to parcellation volume (Freesurfer space)
summary: Resamples a template-surface parcellation to a subject's FreeSurfer surfaces and builds a volumetric parcellation in FreeSurfer space with Connectome Workbench 1.5.0.
description: Resamples left and right label GIFTIs from the template sphere to the subject sphere (wb_command -label-resample), maps them into the FreeSurfer volume with ribbon-constrained label-to-volume mapping, exports the label tables and combines both hemispheres into parc.nii.gz with a label.json. Use it to obtain a subject-space volumetric version of a surface atlas, for example for connectomics.

inputs.description: FreeSurfer recon-all output of the target subject.
Template (for example fsaverage) surfaces for left and right hemispheres on which the labels are defined.
inputs.requirements: Must include ?h.sphere.reg.gii; the App exits otherwise.

inputs.description: Left and right GIFTI label files on the template surfaces, with a label.json key.

outputs.description: Volumetric parcellation (parc.nii.gz) and label.json in FreeSurfer subject space.
Labels resampled to the subject's native surfaces (left.gii, right.gii) and label.json.
Subject pial, white, inflated and sphere.reg surfaces in GIFTI format.

parameters.description:
